platform_horizontal_mode_carry.reading: the player receives the platform's integer X displacement of that update (+$23/+$24, = new X - old X, computed after the move) added to its X; Y is re-snapped to platform Y - 14; no player speed is changed. The vertical movers' +$23/+$24 stays 0, so the lifts and sag platforms carry only in Y.

platform_vs_spike_terrain.reading: the player pass (terrain projection + hurt) runs BEFORE the platform contact test of the same update. A platform whose support plane is above the spike surface (anchor Y 830) holds Sonic clear; if the support plane is within about one fall step of the surface, the next player pass (the landing is only registered at the END of that pass, so the Y integration still runs with the retained speed) or the sinking of a sag platform brings the foot onto the surface and the terrain handler hurts him (the platform never reads the hurt state)
